verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on a taxpayer's data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers notifications, communication channels, tax clarifications, customs lookups and login, with no mention of AI-generated insights or suggestions. The llms.txt probe concerns agent-oriented docs, not in-product AI insights, so it does not count either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
